summary: Security hardening retest (iteration 13). Backend: 29/29 pytest pass (tests/test_security_hardening.py). Verified: JWT_SECRET is required at startup (RuntimeError if it is missing or under 32 chars); tokens signed with the OLD default secret get 401 on /auth/profile, /data/*, stripe checkout and ambassador endpoints; email-signup -> setup-pin -> login-pin and credential-login work; 5 failures lock for 15 min per account AND per IP with the French message (login-pin, credential-login, ambassador/login, admin/*); a successful login resets the counter; X-Forwarded-For spoofing is ignored (checked through the real public ingress: real client IP 34.170.12.145 was used, client-prepended XFF had no effect); /admin/change-password returns 404; webhook without or with a forged signature -> 400 and nothing is activated; generating an activation code and activating it -> subscription active; Stripe test checkout returns a checkout.stripe.com URL; /otp/* and /firebase-auth* -> 404; CORS rejects evil.com and lookalike domains and allows the preview origin. Frontend (375x667): a stale old-secret token is cleared and the login screen shows with no crash; email+password login -> /dashboard; PIN tab login -> /dashboard; the 6th wrong PIN shows the readable red message 'Trop de tentatives échouées. Accès bloqué pendant 15 min...'. Admin HTML: login works, no 'Changer le mot de passe' button, export downloads .json.gz, backups list loads. Ambassador panel login works. No deprecated Expo packages found (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner or firebase in package.json). Found issues are outside the audit scope (unauthenticated /api/reports/*, $undefined commission column) plus design notes.

critical.issue: No authentication at all. analytics exposes admin-level business stats (it currently returns 500, see minor). send-report lets anyone trigger the weekly report email. test-email lets anyone trigger an SMTP login. These were missed by the security audit. Protect them with require_admin or remove them.

minor.issue: 500 AttributeError at reporting.py:98 get_country_from_phone: phone.replace on None. Email-signup users have phoneNumber=None.

The account key is the constant 'admin:acct:admin'. Anyone on the internet can send 5 wrong passwords and lock the real admin out of the backoffice and ambassador panel for 15 min, and repeat this forever. Consider keeping only per-IP lockout for admin, or not letting failures from other IPs block an IP that has succeeded before.

A successful login also deletes the IP counter. An attacker who owns one valid account can log in with it after every 4 failures to reset the per-IP limit, then keep guessing across many accounts (the per-account limit of 5 per 15 min still applies).

No auth: userId comes from the request body (ambassador_api.py:641). Anyone holding a valid code can apply it to any userId, and there is no rate limit on guessing codes. This existed before this session.
Stale startup warning says 'Webhook signature verification is DISABLED' when the secret is empty. The webhook now refuses all events (503) in that case. Update the message.
ADMIN_PASSWORD is read from backend/.env (plaintext file), not from the process environment / Secrets like JWT_SECRET. If 'Secrets only' is required, move it to Secrets.

ui_bugs.issue: COMMISSION column shows '$undefined' for every plan. /api/admin/pricing-info has no 'commission' field per plan (admin_ambassador_panel.py:209). Existed before this session.

issues: Expected login failures are logged with console.error ('PIN login error: ...'), which shows a red LogBox toast over the login button in dev/web preview. Use console.warn or don't log expected 401/429.
